source: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals
executive_summary: Cascade call (financial support to third parties) issued by the StandICT.eu 2029 project (ICT Standardisation Observatory and Support Facility in Europe), funded by Horizon Europe under grant agreement 101213612. Open Call 4 funds individual standardisation specialists residing in EU Member States or Horizon Europe associated countries, from industry, SMEs, academia, research and associations, to contribute to international ICT standards development organisations: long-term contributions of up to EUR 10,000 over at most 9 months and short-term contributions of up to EUR 5,000 over at most 3 months, paid as a lump sum after validated results. Priority topics for this call are data economy, cloud and edge computing and data interoperability (ETSI TC DATA, CEN/CLC JTC25, ISO/IEC JTC1 SC38, ITU-T SG20), but any Rolling Plan for ICT Standardisation topic, including smart grids and smart metering, is eligible. The portal lists a call budget of EUR 650,000. Open from 9 November 2026; deadline 8 January 2027, 17:00.
status_rationale: The StandICT.eu Open Call 4 page (Priority topics, Possible Topics) and the Guidelines for Applicants to Fellowship (sections 1, 3 and 6, pp. 3–8) fund individual experts to contribute to international ICT standards, with smart grids and smart metering and data interoperability among the eligible topics. This touches TenneT's field because grid data exchange and interoperability standards underpin InterOPERA (multi-vendor HVDC interoperability) and TwinEU (cross-border data federation), although the call funds people's standardisation work rather than projects. Section 3 (p. 4) and section 5 (p. 6) require the applicant to be an individual residing in a Member State or associated country, so the call sets out no route for TenneT as an organisation, even if a TenneT employee could apply in a personal capacity: Type 3. C3.4 fits because the funded work advances data-interoperability and smart-grid standards that only benefit TenneT where they are applied to energy.
